The gene expression (log2(TPM+1)) distribution across all cell lines in the dataset is positively skewed (right-skewed). 

Across all 32,017,874 expression measurements (1,673 cell lines × 19,138 genes), the global distribution has a skewness coefficient of approximately +0.690 (mean = 2.6120, median = 2.3423). Across individual cell lines, 100% (1,673/1,673) of the cell lines exhibit positive skewness, with a mean skewness of 0.6942 (median = 0.6792, range = [0.2673, 2.0195]).
